turns.label: Clinician

turns.text: I've lost about 30 pounds in the past, past like 8 months.

turns.text: OK. So, and have you been trying to lose weight?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK and, any, like any changes to your diet or exercise?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and more recently you started to have a cough. When did that start?

turns.text: OK. And prior to this, did you have a cough?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.text: No. And are you bringing bringing up any sputum or phlegm?

turns.text: OK. So you're, you're, you're coughing up blood as well.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uh, and that's been going going on for the last two weeks too?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes.

turns.label: Clinician

turns.label: Patient

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and are there any triggers for your cough that you can think of?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, I don't think so. They just happen throughout the day.

turns.text: OK, and have you tried anything for the cough?

turns.label: Patient

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And so have you had any like viral infectious type symptoms, such as like eye, eye discharge or red eyes or runny nose or even a sore throat?

turns.text: I see, alright. Did you have any other questions for me today? I think that was everything I wanted to ask about for now.

Get a chest X Ray. And if it is tuberculosis, it will require a prolonged course of antibiotics, so that I'll be over several months.
